newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest starts Ingram as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest starts Ingram as hold.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst Kevin McCarthy said he had initiated coverage of Ingram Micro with a hold rating, and said the recommendation was based solely on valuation rather than fundamental concerns.
-- Ingram stock was off 5/8 to 23-1/8 Friday.

-- He noted distribution stocks have come under severe pressure after several reports of disappointing earnings growth and that it trades at 33 percent premium to its closest rival, Tech Data Corp, and 50 percent to the rest of the group, levels he called "excessive."
-- Still, as the world's largest and most profitable distributor the "stock should be allowed some premium," he allowed.

-- He noted that while a slowdown in the industry is not anticipated, the mere threat of a slowing has caused the group's price/earnings multiples to shrink to 13.5 times from 18.5 times six weeks ago. Ingram remains around 20 times.
-- Although he gives credit to Ingram as a well run company and "possibly a bellwether for the industry," Ingram's dominant position may already be factored in the share price.
